quiz.name: Quiz 0: Typing STACK Answers
quiz.intro: This quiz does not count towards your course mark. It is to help you learn how to type mathematical answers in this course. It uses a system called STACK. You can read How to type answers in STACK Page for more information.Attempt this quiz before starting any proper quizz. Make sure that you understand all the answers.
